capabilities: chat about the active note via DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude
preview proposed edits as green/red git-style diffs
accept or reject edits whole or hunk by hunk
append optional global instructions to requests
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a privacy section: no background AI requests; note content is sent only when a chat or inline command is triggered.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and AI edits typically replace note content without letting users review proposed changes first.

requires.name: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key

summary: AI assistant that chats about the active note and previews provider-proposed edits as git-style diffs before you accept or reject them.
